Kenya and Ethiopia are the largest national economies, together contributing roughly 48% of the regional economy.
Nairobi and Addis Ababa are the main economic hubs, while other major economic centres include Dar es Salaam, Kampala, Mombasa, and Kigali.

As of 2026, East Africa’s economies varied significantly in size and wealth with the region having both the most wealthiest countries and most poorest countries in Africa.
